title: Approval Center
subtitle: Review and decide human-approval requests for controlled procurement actions.
emptyDescription: Approval requests you create or can decide will appear here.

guidance.title: How to create an approval request
guidance.body: An approval request begins from a completed AI recommendation. Open a risk, review the recommendation, and choose "Submit for approval".

confirm.title: Approval request
confirm.subtitle: Review the details before submitting. No technical identifiers need to be entered.
confirm.whatHappened: The request was submitted for approval. It is now awaiting a decision from the procurement specialist.
confirm.whoActsNext: The procurement specialist performs the next step.
confirm.missingBody: Recommendation data is missing to submit. Return to the AI analysis and make sure the recommendation is complete.

errors.recommendationNotFound: The selected recommendation could not be found.
errors.invalidRecommendationContent: The recommendation data is not valid.
errors.recommendationNotValidated: The recommendation has not been validated.
errors.riskNotFoundInRecommendation: The risk is not part of the selected recommendation.
errors.actionNotFoundInRecommendation: The action is not part of the selected recommendation.
errors.actionNotRequiringApproval: This action does not require approval.
errors.unsupportedActionType: This action type is not supported.
errors.riskActionParametersMismatch: The action parameters do not match the current risk.
errors.approvalRequestNotFound: The approval request was not found.
errors.approvalRequestNotPending: This request has already been decided.
errors.approvalRequestDuplicate: A pending request already exists for this action.
errors.selfDecisionForbidden: You cannot decide your own request.
errors.approvalServiceError: The approval service could not complete the request.
errors.approvalRequestNotApproved: The approval request has not been approved yet.
errors.approverMismatch: Only the specialist who approved the request can create the task.
errors.bindingMismatch: The task parameters do not match the approved request.
errors.procurementTaskNotFound: The procurement task was not found.
errors.procurementServiceError: The procurement service could not complete the request.
